February 13, 1978

Mr. John Casey
Cosmopolitan Magazine
224 West 57 St.
New York, N. Y. 10019

Dear John:

As you know our client, the R. J. Reynolds Tobacco Co., on behalf of Real cigarettes ran a pop-up coupon in the February issue of Cosmopolitan Magazine.

Since we are all interested in both the redemption and security factors, we will require the following information:

4

1. Quantity of cards received at your bindery.

2. Numbering sequence of these cards.

3. Percentage of copies that contained cards.

4. An affidavit attesting the destruction of all spoilage and/or overs with the sequence #'s destroyed.

May we have this information as soon as possible.

Thank you for your cooperation in this matter.

Yours truly,

[SIGNATURE]

Douglas E. Pfaffler
Print Prod. Exec.
